_note: Rules and texts of the moments (storylets) and message threads (GDD 4.9.5, session C2; StoryletSystem). The moments themselves are in data/storylets/*.json (format in data/storylets/README.md). rate: the week's target number of moments is drawn each Monday from per_week (a moment that waits for an answer counts; one answered by a standing order does not); a day gets one with chance (moments still to come this week) / (days left this week); max_per_day and max_per_week are hard limits (chains included); stops_per_week stop tokens are added each Monday (at most stop_tokens_max): with the setting 'Important only' an important moment needs one to be posted (a chain follow-up that runs out of time is posted without stopping); person_gap_days = the same person writes at most once in that many days; start_after_days = quiet days at the start of a career. expires_days = how long a moment waits for an answer when the moment doesn't say (the last day it can be answered = the day it came + this); then it passes as 'you didn't answer' (no_answer). chain_wait_days = how long a chain follow-up may wait past its day for its conditions. standing: the same reply to a recurring choice (storylets with the same 'standing' group) `repeat` times in a row offers a rule; after 'Not now' it is offered again only after `again_after` more identical answers in a row. relation: each person's relationship 0-100 (the head coach's is his trust, CoachSystem). effects.known = what replies can change now; effects.prepared = accepted and recorded for the systems that come later (moods M1, school S1, family budget C6, coach proposals C4), changing nothing yet.

important.name: Important only
important.text: Play week stops only for moments where your answer changes something. The rest wait in your messages.

all.name: Every moment
all.text: Play week stops for every moment, so you never miss one.

coach.name: Coach
coach.empty: Your coach writes to you here: a talk about the week every Sunday evening, and a message after a race.

family.name: Family
family.empty: Your family will write here about the weekend, school and money. They come in a later update.

friends.name: Friends
friends.empty: Your friends from school will write here. They come in a later update.

group.name: Training group
group.empty: Your training partners will write here as you get to know them.

school.name: School
school.empty: Teachers and the study counsellor will write here. School comes in a later update.

ui.list_note: Messages from the people around you. New ones have a dot.
ui.reply_note: Tap an answer. The line under it says what it may cost.
ui.standing_none: You have no rules yet. When you answer a recurring question the same way twice, the coach offers to make it a rule.

changes._note: The result card after an answer (GDD 4.9.5 'Consequences shown', session C3): what really changed, in words with an arrow and no numbers. trust = the coach's trust (his relationship), relation = another person's, remember = a reply with "remember": true. A change of at most size_limits[0] is 'a little', up to size_limits[1] 'somewhat', more 'a lot'. moods = the moods' labels (session M1; a reply's mood points, sized like trust). Sleep, grades and the budget are listed once their systems exist.
changes.head: WHAT CHANGED

standing.offer_text: You've answered "{reply}" {times} times in a row. Make it a rule: {rule}?
standing.yes_hint: Only the result shows from now on. You can remove rules later.
